discription: A pulse-like sound created by slightly detuning two square waves, producing a rich, evolving timbre with an ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var osc1 = Pulse.ar(freq);    var osc2 = Pulse.ar(freq * 1.005);    sig = (osc1 + osc2) * 0.5;    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
